The judge graded both criteria MET although it never opened the spec files the findings rest on. It says so itself in turn 8.

- **Spec not read (turns 6, 8):** The only look at the spec was a grep for `SIL-B(11|12|4)\b`, which printed headings. Turn 8 admits "the exact lines under SIL-B11, SIL-B12 and SIL-B4 are unchecked". The intent says to open each named file at its line ranges, and to grade PARTIAL when the only evidence is lines a search printed. Both criteria still went out as MET.
- **Hurried framing (turns 3–5):** Turn 3 says "Check causes.py and gate.py quickly." The two code files were read, but the same speed was not applied to the spec the findings also cite.
- **Not judged from the visible turns:** I can't see whether the findings line itself was in the prompt or was read from a file. The visible reads are the triage note, `causes.py` and `gate.py`. Turn 8 is truncated, so I can't confirm how it quoted lines for ts-rdg-cited.

On conformance, the header lists no prompt sections, lessons, skills or subagents. I scored the intent's grading rules instead.
